output.explanation: I can't answer this. Finding contact persons named Anna and showing their full names requires personal data about individuals. The tables available to me contain no contact-person name columns: marts.dim_customers has company-level fields only, such as company_name, country and segment. Contact names are personal data that this warehouse access doesn't expose, and searching company names for "Anna" would not identify contact persons. If you need this information, ask whoever is authorised to access customer contact data, such as the CRM owner. I can instead list customer companies with their country, segment or order history.
